name: Kawasaki Ninja 250R
intro: The classic learner Ninja. Very tough. Check the few early recalls and look for drop damage.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Recalls include the front brake hose bracket on some 2008 bikes (08V115), engine case oil leaks on some 2009-2010 bikes (09V464) and passenger footpeg circlips on some 2012 bikes (12V081).
A-002.reason: These affect brakes, oil on the tire and pegs. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Porous engine case may leak oil onto the rear tire.
